title: Riot Squad BAR EDTN Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pineapple Ice from Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN range is totally tropical burst of sunny flavour that’s every bit as refreshing as it is sweet and tangy. That deliciously fresh and juicy Pineapple flavour is lifted to exquisite new heights with a frosty layer of bracing menthol, bringing an ice-cool kick to every exhale. This e-liquid’s 60% PG / 40% VG formulation delivers the perfect balance of flavour and cloud production while the nicotine salt formulation ensures a super-smooth and comfortable throat sensation. Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN e-liquids are perfect for use in starter vape kits and low-powered pod devices. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than high-strength freebase liquids are capable of. With nicotine salt e-liquids, the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings. This makes Nic salt e-liquids a great choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by Nic salts. BAR EDTN is a mouth-watering collection of nic salt e-liquids inspired by Riot Squad’s hugely popular disposable Riot Bar flavours . Just like those Riot Bars, Bar EDTN keeps the flavours simple, sweet, and deliciously satisfying, so you always know how your e-juice will taste before you buy it. If you love this flavour, why not treat yourself to the others in Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN collection? From super-refreshing Watermelon Ice to a classic Cherry Cola and smooth and creamy Mango Vanilla, whatever your taste in e-liquid, BAR EDTN has an incredible flavour waiting for you.
